arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys, json, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
rng = random.Random(5)
N=256; R=8192; T=1; S=8
fab={"n":N,"interval_ns":T,"slice_ns":S,"offset_ns":0,"drift_ppb":[rng.randint(0,1000) for _ in range(N)],
     "heat":[[rng.randrange(N),rng.randint(0,7),rng.randint(8,8),0] for _ in range(100)],
     "anchors":[[i,0,8] for i in range(16)],
     "links":[{"ends":[[i,0,0],[N-1-i,0,0]],"delay_ns":[3,3],"defer_rounds":[1,1]} for i in range(128)],
     "slices":[list(range(128))],"blackouts":[[rng.randrange(128),rng.randint(0,7),rng.randint(8,8)] for _ in range(50)],
     "guards_ns":[0],"reconfig_ns":0}
# heat/anchor ranges must be < P: P = 8/gcd(1,8)=8 -> use ranges within [0,8]
fab["heat"]=[[h[0],h[1],8,0] for h in fab["heat"]]
fab["blackouts"]=[[b[0],b[1],8] for b in fab["blackouts"]]
prof={"groups":1,"jitter_ps":[5],"measurements":[]}
# rate limits: eff rate = drift (no heat extra)
eff=[fab["drift_ppb"] for _ in range(8)]
sends=[]
ids=rng.sample(range(1,10**9), 65536)
for j in range(65536):
    code=rng.randrange(256)
    tick=rng.randrange(R)
    sends.append([ids[j],tick,code,rng.randint(-10**7,10**7)])
trace={"rounds":R,"rates_ppb":[[rng.randint(-eff[t%8][i],eff[t%8][i]) for i in range(N)] for t in range(R)],
       "bias_ps":[3],"sends":sends,"lost":[s[0] for s in sends[:5000]],
       "reboots":[[rng.randint(0,R),rng.randrange(N)] for _ in range(2000)],
       "queries":[rng.randint(0,R) for _ in range(1024)]}
req={"op":"replay","profile":prof,"fabric":fab,"guard_ns":0,"trace":trace}
open('big_replay.jsonl','w').write(json.dumps(req))
print('written')
EOF
cd /workspace/tmp && time (timeout 170 python3 -B /workspace/submission/main.py < big_replay.jsonl > big_rout.json; echo exit=$?); python3 -c "
import json
d=json.loads(open('/workspace/tmp/big_rout.json').read().strip())
print({k:(v if not isinstance(v,list) else len(v)) for k,v in d.items() if k!='states'})
print('states',len(d['states']))"
